app.notes: Working in a folder now survives the commonest way a model gets it wrong. A file travels inside a strict envelope and models pack it badly, especially anything with code in it; the app now reads the file out of a badly packed one and shows you the whole thing before writing, as always. A call that genuinely arrives incomplete says so truthfully instead of blaming the length. Long files can be written in parts, so a whole game no longer has to fit in one reply. A plain answer cut short at its length limit now says so too. And Use Gonka now states plainly, before you pick a service and at the top of every conversation, that what you send travels to whichever computer on the network answers it and whoever runs it can see it.
